Sida has supported the Nairobi based regional organization, Education Center for Women in Democracy (ECWD) to implement two programs namely 'Women Direct' (Contibution no. 31000145) which was running between 2004-2007 and a second program entitled 'Enhancing Women's Capacity for Transformative Leadership in Greater Eastern Africa' (Contribution no. 31100027) planned to be implemented between 2007 to 2011. The agreements for these programs were signed by the Swedish Embassy in Nairobi and Sida respectively. However, due to internal governance problems and mismanagement of funds, Sida hs decided to freeze funds and eventually terminate the later agreement prematurely in 2009. As per the records, there was only one narrative progress report that was submitted by the partner in 2008 and and thus it is not possible to assess if there were any results that were achieved in the program.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
